cooling_description: Free-cooling air-cooled chillers with variable speed compressors specified for the data hall areas; Air Source Heat Pumps serving front-of-house office/admin areas. No water consumption figures published in the documents reviewed.
notes: Water demand, supply arrangements and drought resilience are specifically flagged as undisclosed by the local petition; the council PAN report requires the applicant to demonstrate acceptability on water consumption. A separate Cundall sustainability report (ADC-CDL-XX-XX-T-SY-70221) covering water consumption is referenced but was not located.
